svg.title: Callback overshoot across three input patterns
svg.desc: Overshoot beyond a 50 ms quiet period, 30 interleaved bursts per pattern; filled points are medians, hollow points p95, not uncertainty intervals. One value, 20 at once, and 60 every 5 ms; shared 0–4 ms scale. All nine median and p95 values are printed alongside their points.
